# Google Search

> Google Search's comprehensive platform for discovering and exploring information through AI-powered search, visual recognition, voice interaction, and immersive augmented reality experiences.

Google Search combines traditional web search with cutting-edge AI capabilities including generative AI overviews, multimodal search through Lens and Circle to Search, and voice-based interaction. The platform emphasizes accessibility and innovation through features powered by Gemini and integration across mobile and web experiences.

## Key Topics

- AI Overviews
- AI Mode
- Google Lens
- Circle to Search
- Voice Search
- Augmented Reality (AR)
- Gemini
- Generative AI
- Visual Search
- Mobile Search
- Google App
- Discover
- Image Search
- Shopping
- Google Labs

## AI-Powered Search

- [AI in Search](https://search.google/ai-in-search): Overview of AI capabilities in Google Search including Gemini, AI Overviews, AI Mode.
- [Google AI Overviews](https://search.google/ways-to-search/ai-overviews): AI Overviews product page for generative AI-powered search results.
- [Google AI Mode](https://search.google/ways-to-search/ai-mode): AI Mode product page powered by Gemini for deep research and multimodal search.

## Visual & Multimodal Search

- [Google Lens](https://search.google/ways-to-search/lens): Google Lens visual search product page for image and camera-based search.
- [Circle to Search](https://search.google/ways-to-search/circle-to-search): Circle to Search gesture-based mobile search feature for Android devices.
- [AR](https://search.google/ways-to-search/ar): Augmented reality search features for immersive 3D visualization and shopping.

## Search Methods & Interaction

- [Voice Search](https://search.google/ways-to-search/voice): Voice search capabilities including voice commands and humming recognition.
- [Discover](https://search.google/ways-to-search/discover): Discover feature for personalized content recommendations and search methods.
- [Google App](https://search.google/google-app): Google App mobile application with Lens, voice search, translation, shopping.

## Learning & Support

- [Tips & Tricks](https://search.google/tips-tricks): Search tips, shortcuts, and how-to guides for Google Search features.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://search.google): Google Search homepage showcasing Lens, AI Overviews, Labs, voice search.
